mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) for two consecutive months indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as revenue expectations fall.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) signals manufacturing slowdown and supply chain disruption, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate output expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) over the prior 3 months indicates strengthening residential investment and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST has risen for three consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) for two consecutive months indicate labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE increases and PAYEMS declines for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 7.0%) suppresses consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as economic weakness intensifies.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods where UNRATE > 7.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.
